title: Hello, World
description:
The traditional first program. Type it out yourself (do not paste): your fingers learn the shape of a C++ program faster than your eyes do.

Print exactly:

```
Hello, World!
```
hints: Printing looks like this: `std::cout << "some text\n";` The `\n` at the end moves to a new line.
Capital letters, the comma and the exclamation mark all matter. The output is compared character by character.
